legend.en: Knowing that this strategically vital site must be secure for the defence lines to hold, Space Marines stand indomitable in the face of the foe.

target.en: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is within range of an objective.

effect.en: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

legend.en: Aware of how vital it is that the defence line holds, these warriors fight even to their last breath.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units).

effect.en: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls. Or: If your unit is entrenched, attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.

legend.en: Auto-sense targeting subroutines specially adapted for defensive fire patterns aid these warriors’ aim.

when.en: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.

effect.en: Your unit’s attacks have: [LETHAL HITS]. Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Or: If your unit is entrenched, [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

legend.en: Steadfast and determined, the Imperial Fists favour methodical advances, securing and consolidating positions to establish battlefield dominance before turning their attention to the elimination of remaining foes.

when.en: Fight phase, when a friendly entrenched ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to make a consolidation move.

effect.en: You can select the objective consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move’s Before Moving restrictions. Designer’s Note: This means your unit can move out of engagement range with enemy units, provided it meets the conditions of the objective consolidation mode.

legend.en: Eliminating key enemy assets is crucial to stalling then reversing the foe’s momentum.

when.en: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit is selected to attack.

effect.en: Your unit’s attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, have +1 to wound rolls.

legend.en: Codex doctrine when conducting an aggressive defence is to swiftly take up new positions whenever the foe finds your range.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.

target.en: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.

effect.en: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6". Or: If your unit is entrenched, your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3". Your unit is not able to embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.
